subject: terrapup
disposition: Meshy retexture maps on a byte-identical copy of the installed rigged GLB (assets/creatures/tetherbound/terrapup/models/creature_terrapup_lod0.glb: mesh, UVs, skin, skeleton and clips unchanged), so the F36 pose recipes apply unchanged; flag-off candidate beside it. species.json binding and the installed model are unchanged.
authorization: Standing owner direction 1 (Meshy, no generation cap); CLAUDE.md art rule

meshy_tasks.label: v1_s1
style_image_reference_images: render of installed GLB (3/4 view, existing texture), scratchpad refs/terrapup__installed_34.png
meshy_tasks.verdict: good: dark umber fur, cream blaze/muzzle/chest, olive moss in plate seams, leather-brown pads; but cream patches on legs/hips. Alternate.

meshy_tasks.label: v2_s2
style_image_reference_images: render of installed GLB (3/4 view, existing texture), scratchpad refs/terrapup__installed_34.png
meshy_tasks.verdict: CHOSEN: even dark umber on body and all legs (no cream patches), clean cream blaze, muzzle, chest and belly, grey plates with olive moss seams, matte leather brown-grey paw pads, teal eyes. Hue-flagged texels are very dark warm brown on inner ears, nose and pad edges (mean RGB 53,38,33), not visibly red.

transfer.uv_check: TEXCOORD_0 unique UV sets identical (15616 values; the script refuses otherwise)
transfer.byte_identity_check: meshes, accessors, skins, nodes, animations, scenes and samplers JSON equal; all 333 non-image bufferViews byte-identical to the installed GLB (the script refuses otherwise)
transfer.maps: base colour (red-clamped, PNG), metallic-roughness (Meshy factors 1.0/1.0) and normal from the retexture GLB embedded images; every other material field kept from the installed material
transfer.red_clamp_note: Clamp limited to visibly red/pink texels (sat >0.45, value >0.35): none. The 0.90% texels the shared red metric flags are very dark warm brown on inner ears, nose and pad edges (value <=0.29, mean RGB 62,43,39) and are left as painted.

scale_note: Same mesh and runtime fit as the installed terrapup (3.85 m); trainer 1.80 m.
colourway_note: No vivid/shiny/alpha sibling textures were generated; the candidate shows its embedded maps.
follow_up: Judge in engine under the F36 pose recipes before enabling.

license.source: Meshy API existing owner credits; no new purchase

material_note: The installed emissive map (faint, max 0.25, 0.3% of texels) and KHR_materials_specular are kept unchanged from the installed material.

variant_v2.request: Creatures lane code-blind judges (v1 5.93): fur mid-brown (neither dark chocolate nor orange); cream blaze, muzzle and chest; stones mid-grey (albedo ~0.5) with olive moss in the cracks.
variant_v2.method: deterministic masked HSV grading of the v1 Meshy retexture base colour (no new Meshy pass)
variant_v2.meshy_tasks: none (0 credits); maps derive from the v1 retexture recorded above
variant_v2.scale: Same mesh, skin, clips and runtime fit as v1 and the installed lod0; only the base-colour image differs.
variant_v2.generation_verdict: Fur lifted from dark chocolate (median value 0.19) to mid-brown (~0.40, hue 20-32, not orange); blaze, muzzle and chest warm cream (hue 40, sat 0.13-0.24); stones neutral mid-grey at median albedo 0.50; moss in the cracks olive (hue ~72). Red metric 0.90% -> 0%. Pads and claws read lighter beige than v1. Not a judge verdict.
